mass_source: 1200 kg, the low end of Wikipedia's 1200-1350 kg for the Lambda; Classic & Sports Car gives 1065 kg for a fourth-series car. No occupants.

steering_servo.note: Acts at the pitman; with the 8:1 box, 80 N m there is 10 N m at the steering wheel.

suspension.note: Front: 30 kN/m per pillar (about 80 mm static deflection under ~250 kg sprung per wheel) with a hydraulic damper at about 0.35 of critical, 1.9 kN s/m. Rear: 86 kN/m heave (two semi-elliptics, about 40 mm static deflection) with light viscous damping plus the friction dampers as 300 N of dry friction at the axle (60 N m in roll); roll rate from 0.9 m spring spacing. Preloads are calibrated at run time to the design ride height.

tire.note: Beaded-edge pneumatic tyres of the period: shared compliant contact, round crown 50 mm half-width.

assumptions: Mass split, centre of mass (front engine, deep hull), inertia, spring rates, damping and the friction-damper force are estimates.
